notes.title: We will no longer update the unlocked countdown.
notes.content:
Once we solve the game classification problem, we will unlock the game immediately.The longer the drag is, the more likely the English version will be launched synchronously. XD


The good news is that the name part of our equipment has been translated.

So……like this.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31149170/8fae8d8ae8476e6e0bbe69e0e375763a80a96c0d.jpg

Any wait is worth it. Thank you for your patience.
